info.title: Business Application Platform API (BAPI)
info.description: Unofficial. BAPI (api.bap.microsoft.com) is the undocumented legacy Power Platform admin API behind the admin center. This spec is reverse-engineered from the wire behavior encoded in microsoft/terraform-provider-power-platform's client (internal/clients/bapi) — itself derived from admin-center traffic recordings — and is a map, not a contract. api-version defaults vary per operation (2019-10-01 through 2023-06-01) and the PowerPlatform.Governance operations take none at all; response shapes list only fields the provider consumes, and nothing is marked required because the service's own optionality is unverified. Mutations are largely asynchronous: a 202 hands back a Location URL that renders a LifecycleOperation. Sovereign-cloud hosts (.us, .cn, eaglex, microsoft.scloud) serve the same paths.

post.description: Provisions an environment, optionally with a linked Dataverse organization. Responds 201 with the created environment when provisioning completes synchronously, or 202 with a lifecycle operation whose final `links.environment.path` ends in the new environment id. 409 with `OperationNotStartable` means another lifecycle operation is in flight and the request can be replayed once it finishes; 409 with `InsufficientCapacity_StorageDriven` means the tenant is out of database capacity. 500 responses carry a JSON error body worth surfacing verbatim.

Retry-After.description: Suggested poll interval. Delta seconds, an HTTP date, or (non-standard, observed) a Go duration string.

get.description: Polls an asynchronous operation. Clients must treat the 202 response's Location (or Operation-Location) header as the authoritative poll URL — this path documents its observed shape, and some operations hand back differently-shaped URLs on the same host. Terminal states are `Succeeded` and `Failed`; 409 means the operation cannot be reported yet and the poll should continue; a 404 after a delete means the resource (and its operation record) is already gone.

200.description: The operation. Poll until `state.id` is `Succeeded` or `Failed`.

patch.description: Patches environment properties. Three request shapes are in active use: a general `Environment` patch (display name, description, cadence, linked-metadata fields — sent with `$expand` and, deliberately, api-version 2021-04-01 because newer versions turn on Managed Environments as a side effect of description-only updates), a `GenerativeAiFeatures` patch (Copilot/Bing chat and cross-geo data-movement toggles; 204 when nothing changes), and a `DisasterRecoveryPatch` (flips `properties.states.disasterRecovery`). Regional read-after-write lag applies: a succeeded lifecycle operation does not guarantee the next GET reflects the change.

parameters.name: $expand
parameters.description: Sent by the general update variant only: `permissions,properties.capacity,properties/billingPolicy`.

azure_auth.description: Microsoft Entra ID OAuth2. BAPI accepts tokens for the PowerApps service audience.

direction.description: Which connection directions this tenant exception permits.

crossGeoCopilotDataMovementEnabled.description: Allows Copilot requests to move data across geos where the model is hosted elsewhere.

crossBoundaryCopilotDataMovementEnabled.description: The EU Data Boundary variant of the cross-geo consent.

type.description: `Microsoft.BusinessAppPlatform/scopes/environments` — resource-id form of the environment reference.

environmentType.description: `AllEnvironments`, `OnlyEnvironments` or `ExceptEnvironments`; the environments list applies to the latter two.

location.description: The BAP location name (for example `unitedstates`, `europe`), not an Azure region.

name.description: The environment id (a GUID). BAPI calls it `name`.

code.description: Numeric deletion-reason code as a string; the admin center sends `7` (application-initiated).

message.description: Free-text audit note stored with the deletion.

azureRegion.description: Concrete Azure region inside the location; assignable at create only where the location lists it.

environmentSku.description: The environment type: Sandbox, Production, Trial, Developer or Default.

provisioningState.description: Moves through `LinkedDatabaseProvisioning` while Dataverse is provisioning; terminal value `Succeeded`.

bingChatEnabled.description: Copilot answer grounding via Bing web search.

m365Enabled.description: Copilot grounding on Microsoft 365 service data.

excludeEnvironmentFromAnalysis.description: String booleans ("true"/"false"), not JSON booleans - as are the rest of these extended settings.

solutionCheckerMode.description: `none`, `warn` or `block`: solution-checker enforcement on solution import.

bingChatEnabled.description: See EnvironmentProperties.bingChatEnabled; pointer semantics — omitted fields are left untouched.

localeId.description: The LCID (for example 1033 for en-US) used as `baseLanguage` at environment creation.

LifecycleOperation.description: An asynchronous BAPI operation, polled via the URL a 202 response hands back in Location/Operation-Location.

backgroundOperationsState.description: Whether background flows/jobs are running or administratively paused.

domainName.description: The chosen Dataverse subdomain; must be tenant-unique (validateEnvironmentDetails checks it).

instanceUrl.description: Root URL of the Dataverse organization; its host is the Dataverse Web API host.

baseLanguage.description: LCID from the location's environmentLanguages list.

securityGroupId.description: Entra group restricting Dataverse access. The service returns empty for 'unrestricted'; the all-zeros GUID means the same thing on writes.

canProvisionDatabase.description: Whether environments here may include Dataverse.

azureRegions.description: Azure regions selectable via `properties.azureRegion` when creating environments in this location.

aadDataBoundary.description: The Entra data boundary (for example the EU Data Boundary) the tenant is pinned to.

fedRAMPHighCertificationRequired.description: Whether the tenant demands FedRAMP-High-certified service placement.

isDisabled.description: The policy object can exist while disabled; false means isolation is enforced.
